name: 🌵 Southwest Black Bean & Egg Salad
what: Chopped hard-boiled eggs, black beans and corn in a creamy salsa-lime dressing.
early: Sunday: boil a dozen eggs for this and snacks.
extras: frozen corn, avocado, lime, cumin, cilantro, tortilla chips or lettuce cups

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter.
No boiled eggs? Cover 8 eggs with cold water, boil, cover, heat off, wait 10 min, then ice water.
Stir yogurt, salsa, lime, cumin and salt into a dressing.
Fold in the chopped eggs, beans and corn.
Avocado in last. Scoop with chips or lettuce.

key: Yogurt + salsa is the whole dressing. Creamy, with a little zip.
done: Eggs peel clean and the yolks are fully yellow.
plan_b: No time for eggs? Make it a bean and corn salsa and eat it with chips.
